senses.gloss: to expand, make large, fatten.—Part. pass. פָּטוּם; f. פְּטוּמָה; pl. פְּטוּמִים, פְּטוּמִין; פְּטוּמוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:10">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> <he>פטומות</he> crammed birds; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:25">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> bot. Y’lamd. to Gen. XXXVII quot. in Ar., v. <cite ref="O00607"><he>סיטוסימה</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to pound spices; to manufacture perfumed oil; to compound incense. Y. Succ. V, 55ᶜ bot. תיקנוה ולא היתה מְפַטֶּמֶת וכ׳ they mended the mortar, but it did not mix the drugs as well as before; Arakh. 10ᵇ.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 1:1">Ker. I, 1</cite> <he>המְפַטֵּם את השמן</he> he that manufactures perfumed oil (in the same manner as prescribed for the Temple, <cite ref="Exodus 30:23">Ex. XXX, 23</cite> sq.); <he>המפ׳ את הקטרת</he> who mixes incense (as prescribed ib. 34 sq.). Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ bot. <he>פּיטְּמָהּ חציים</he> if he compounded it by taking only parts of the quantities prescribed; <cite ref="Keritot 5a:67">Ker. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>מפטם לחציין</he>, v. <cite ref="H01518"><he>חֵצִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 5a:69">Ib.</cite> <he>קטרת שפִּטְּמָהּ וכ׳</he> incense which one compounded in reduced quantities; <he>שמן שפִּטְּמוֹ וכ׳</he> oil which one manufactured &c.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 306:19-22">Sifré Deut. 306</cite> <he>מה רביבים … ומפטמים אותם</he> as the rains coming down on plants … perfume them; <he>כך הוי מפטם בדברי תורה וכ׳</he> so pound thou the words of the Law, once and a second, and a third, and a fourth time &c.; Yalk. ib. 942; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְפוּטָּם</he>; f. <he>מְפוּטֶּמֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְפוּטָּמִים</he>; <he>מְפוּטָּמִין</he>; <he>מְפוּטָּמוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:2:1">Cant. R. to VIII, 2</cite> (ref. to <he>יין הרקח</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:2:1">ib.</cite>) <he>זה התלמוד שמפ׳ במשניות כרקח</he> that is the Talmud which is mixed with Mishnayoth like an apothecary’s preparation.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite> (play on <he>פ̇וט̇יפ̇ר̇</he>) <he>שהיה מפ̇ט̇ם עגלים לע״ז</he> he fattened calves (<he>פ̇רים</he>) for idolatrous purposes.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82b:5">Snh. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>ראיתם בן פ̇וט̇י זה שפ̇יט̇ם אבי אמו וכ׳</he> do you see that son of Puti (= Putiel) whose grandfather (Yethro) fattened calves &c.?; <cite ref="Bava Batra 109b">B. Bath. 109ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 43a">Sot. 43ᵃ</cite> (v. <cite ref="Q00186"><he>פּוּטִי</he></cite> a. <cite ref="Q00188"><he>פּוּטִיאֵל</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:1">Esth. R. to III, 1</cite> (ref. to <he>כיקר כרים</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 37:20">Ps. XXXVII, 20</cite>) ‘like the heavy lambs’, <he>שאין מפטמין אותן וכ׳</he> which are fattened not for their own benefit but for slaughter; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite> (expl. <he>בריאים</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 5:3">I Kings V, 3</cite>) <he>מפ׳</he> (not <cite ref="A01567"><he>אפ׳</he></cite>) fattened, opp. <he>מן המרעה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 176:2">Yalk. Kings 176</cite>.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite> <he>עגלות מפ׳</he> fattened calves; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>ומה אם להסגר … להִפָּטֵם וכ׳</he> if to be locked up … the beasts came of their own accord, how much more will they come to fatten on the flesh of the mighty (<cite ref="Ezekiel 39:4">Ez. XXXIX, 4</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 380">Yalk. Ez. 380</cite>.
